name: Inpatient Hospital
description: Acute inpatient care paid under IPPS using DRGs. Subject to mandatory Hospital VBP, HRRP, and HAC reduction payment adjustments.

name: Outpatient Hospital
description: Hospital outpatient and ASC services paid under OPPS/ASC fee schedule using Ambulatory Payment Classifications.

name: Physician / Professional Services
description: Physician and eligible professional services paid under the PFS. Subject to QPP (MIPS or Advanced APM) payment adjustments.
innovationModels: Value in Opioid Use Disorder Treatment

name: Skilled Nursing Facility
description: Post-acute SNF care paid under SNF PPS (PDPM). Subject to SNF VBP payment adjustments. Eligible as downstream episode participant for surgical and medical bundles.

name: Home Health
description: Skilled home health services paid under HH PPS (PDGM). Subject to HHVBP quality-linked payment adjustments nationally since 2022.

name: Hospice
description: Palliative per-diem care for beneficiaries with a terminal prognosis of ≤6 months. Hospice spending included in ACO benchmark expenditures.

name: Inpatient Rehabilitation Facility
description: Intensive inpatient rehab paid under IRF PPS using Case-Mix Groups. Eligible as downstream participant in surgical episode bundles.

name: End-Stage Renal Disease
description: Dialysis services paid under ESRD PPS as a bundled per-treatment rate. Home dialysis encouraged through expanded coverage and transitional add-on payments.

name: Oncology
description: Cancer diagnosis, treatment, and management paid under PFS (with Part B drug buy-and-bill) or Part D. Oncology practices subject to MIPS oncology specialty set.

name: Behavioral Health
description: Mental health and SUD services paid under PFS. Mental Health Parity applies to MA and Medicaid managed care. OTP Medicare bundled payment for opioid treatment.
innovationModels: Value in Opioid Use Disorder Treatment

name: Medicare Advantage / Health Plan
description: Medicare Advantage (Part C) managed care plans receive risk-adjusted capitation payments per enrollee. Plans take on full insurance risk for Medicare benefits.
innovationModels: States Advancing All-Payer Health Equity Approaches

name: Prescription Drug (Part D)
description: Outpatient prescription drug benefit administered by private Part D plan sponsors. IRA 2022 created Medicare Drug Price Negotiation, out-of-pocket cap, and manufacturer rebate rules.
